'''
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text(poc)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":602,"var":"nargs","code":"if (nargs == 2) { v1 = argtod(args[0]); v2 = argtod(args[1]); } else continue;","note":"The malformed \pos(,) payload is accepted as two parenthesized arguments, each empty after trimming."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"argtod","line":54,"var":"arg.start","code":"mystrtod(&arg.start, &value);","note":"Empty arguments are converted through the numeric parser, leaving the current pointer at the argument start."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":611,"var":"render_priv->state.pos_x / pos_y","code":"render_priv->state.pos_x = v1; render_priv->state.pos_y = v2;","note":"The empty coordinates are propagated into positioned-event state and used during rendering."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The renderer later hashes descriptor string members during cache lookup."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"If an empty string view reaches this helper with zero length, the hash loop dereferences buf and can fault."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))

python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
